section-64-1.FOR: the person carrying on a private children’s home
section-64-1.TO: — (a) safeguard and promote a child’s welfare; (b) make such use of the services and facilities available for children cared for by their own parents as appears to that person reasonable in the case of the child; and (c) advise, assist and befriend him with a view to promoting his welfare when he ceases to be so accommodated
section-64-1.WHERE: the child is accommodated in the home

section-64-2.FOR: the person carrying on the home
section-64-2.TO: ascertain the wishes and feelings of— (a) the child; (b) his parents; (c) any other person who is not a parent of his but who has parental responsibility for him; and (d) any person whose wishes and feelings the person carrying on the home considers to be relevant, regarding the matter to be decided
section-64-2.BEFORE: making any decision with respect to any such child

section-64-3.TO: give due consideration— (a) having regard to the child’s age and understanding, to such wishes and feelings of his as he has been able to ascertain; (b) to such other wishes and feelings mentioned in subsection (2) as he has been able to ascertain; and (c) to the child’s religious persuasion, racial origin and cultural and linguistic background

section-65-1.FOR: A person who is disqualified (under section 68) from fostering a child privately
section-65-1.TO: carry on, or be otherwise concerned in the management of, or have any financial interest in a children’s home in Wales
section-65-1.UNLESS: he has— (a) disclosed to the appropriate authority the fact that he is so disqualified; and (b) obtained its written consent

section-65-2.TO: employ a person who is so disqualified in a children’s home in Wales
section-65-2.UNLESS: he has— (a) disclosed to the appropriate authority the fact that that person is so disqualified; and (b) obtained its written consent

section-65-3.TO: inform the applicant by a written notice which states— (a) the reason for the refusal; (b) the applicant’s right to appeal under section 65A against the refusal to the First-tier Tribunal (c) the time within which he may do so
section-65-3.WHERE: it refuses to give its consent under this section

section-65-A1.FOR: A person (“P”) who is disqualified (under section 68) from fostering a child privately
section-65-A1.TO: carry on, or be otherwise concerned in the management of, or have any financial interest in, a children's home in England
section-65-A1.UNLESS: — (a) P has, within the period of 28 days beginning with the day on which P became aware of P's disqualification, disclosed to the appropriate authority the fact that P is so disqualified, and (b) P has obtained the appropriate authority's written consent

section-65-A2.TO: employ a person (“P”) who is so disqualified in a children's home in England
section-65-A2.UNLESS: — (a) E has, within the period of 28 days beginning with the day on which E became aware of P's disqualification, disclosed to the appropriate authority the fact that P is so disqualified, and (b) E has obtained the appropriate authority's written consent

section-65A-2.TO: confirm the authority’s decision or direct it to give the consent in question
